Prachi Construction Projects

Prachi Construction Projects is a construction company based in Mota Varachha, Surat, Gujarat, India. The company focuses on textile and industrial construction in Surat and nearby industrial areas, including gala units, airjet and waterjet loom sheds, loom machine foundations, processing-house civil work and industrial sheds. The site states 10+ years of construction experience and offers labour-only or labour-and-material contracts.

Office: Green Plaza, 129, near D Mart Road, Mota Varachha, Surat, Gujarat 394101
Phone: +91 76004 90851
Email: prachiconstructionprojects@gmail.com
Website: https://prachiconstructionprojects.github.io/

Services
- Textile gala unit construction
- Airjet loom shed construction
- Waterjet loom shed construction
- Loom machine foundation work
- Textile processing house and dyeing/printing unit civil work
- Industrial shed, pre-engineered building (PEB), warehouse and godown construction
- RCC structure, foundations and industrial flooring
- Labour-only and labour-and-material turnkey contracts

Areas served
Surat, Mota Varachha, Varachha, Pandesara, Sachin GIDC, Udhna, Katargam, Kadodara, Palsana, Kamrej, Sayan, Olpad, Puna-Kumbhariya and Bhestan.
